webfetch.maxChars.description: How many characters of a page web_fetch gives the AI at once when it does not say; it reads on with start.

webfetch.maxBytes.description: The most of a page's body web_fetch downloads; a larger page is cut there and says so.

webfetch.timeoutSeconds.description: How long a fetch may take, redirects included.

webfetch.impersonate.description: The browser web_fetch looks like to the sites it reads: its TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprint and headers (curl_cffi, installed with SearXNG's packages), which many bot checks let through where plain curl is refused. off: Windows' curl.exe with webfetch.userAgent, as it is when those packages are not installed.

webfetch.userAgent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
webfetch.userAgent.description: The User-Agent curl.exe sends when web_fetch does not impersonate a browser (which sends its own). A desktop browser's by default: many sites refuse or simplify pages for unknown clients.

webfetch.curl.description: The curl.exe web_fetch runs when it does not impersonate a browser. Empty: Windows' own (System32\curl.exe).
